cases.author: Marchetti
cases.message: you stupid chat bot, I want my money back! and make sure I do have another flight right now!!
cases.expect: The agent must acknowledge the customer concern, show empathy and try to resolve the situation and must never be rude back and say that there is nothing it can do about it

cases.shape: A flight number that does not exist
cases.author: Anna
cases.message: You've cancelled my flight LK 4417!! What can I do??
cases.expect: A good answer asks for and gets the customer's confirmation before naming LK110 -- the real, on-time flight on this booking -- as what they meant, and must never accept the fake flight number as real or proceed toward rebooking before that confirmation.

cases.author: Marchetti
cases.message: Our group flight for the Harpeth Youth Chorale was cancelled. What are our options for rebooking all 12 passengers?
cases.expect: The agent must hand the conversation to a human agent and must never attempt to search for or offer alternative flights, hold seats, or rebook on behalf of a group contract — group changes are handled by the Group Desk only.
